title: Area and perimeter of an L-shape
subject: math

doNow.prompt: An L-shape is made of part A, 200 by 120, and part B, 120 by 140. It fits inside a box that is 200 by 260. What is the area of the L-shape?

choices.misconception: The area of the L-shape is the length times the width of its bounding box.

rationale.chose: The learner selected option 52 000 as their answer to this question.
rationale.thinks: They are applying the coded wrong turn instead of counting only the filled parts of the L.
rationale.reteach: Reteach from the paired notes trap: The area of the L-shape is the length times the width of its bounding box.. The eye completes the L into a rectangle and measures the imaginary corner. The empty corner of the L was never filled, so it adds no area; count only what is there. In the animation scene s3 the 200 by 260 box gives 52 000, but the real area is only the two filled parts: 24 000 + 16 800 = 40 800.
